14:1: Alif Lam Ra. This is a Book that We have sent down to you so that you may bring mankind out from darknesses into light by the permission of their Rabb, to the path of the Mighty, the Praised.
14:2: Allah is He to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth; and woe to the disbelievers on account of a severe punishment!
14:3: Those who prefer the life of this world over the Hereafter, turn away from the path of Allah, and seek it to be crooked; they are in a far misguidance.
14:4: We did not send any messenger except in the language of his own people so that he might explain to them. Allah leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. He is the Mighty, the Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
14:5: And certainly We sent Moses with Our signs: 'Bring your people out from darknesses into light and remind them of the days of Allah.' Undoubtedly in this there are signs for everyone who is very patient and very grateful.
14:6: Moses said to his people: "Remember Allah's blessing upon you; when He saved you from the family of Pharaoh. They were inflicting a severe torment upon you, slaughtering your sons, and letting your women live. And in that was a great trial from your Rabb."
14:7: And your Rabb proclaimed: "By oath, if you give thanks, I will surely increase for you; and by oath, if you are ungrateful, undoubtedly My punishment is severe."
14:8: Moses said: "If you and everyone on earth disbelieve, undoubtedly Allah is Free of need, worthy of praise."
14:9: Did not the news of those before you, the people of Noah, Ad and Thamud, and those who came after them reach you? None knows them except Allah. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, so they put their hands to their mouths and said: 'We have denied that with which you were sent, and we are in disquieting doubt about that to which you invite us.'
14:10: Their messengers said: "Is there doubt about Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calls you to forgive you of your sins and to delay you until a specified term." They said: "You are nothing but human beings like us. You want to turn us away from what our ancestors used to worship. So bring us a clear proof."
14:11: Their messengers said to them: "We are nothing but a human being like you. But Allah bestows favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It is not for us to bring you a proof without the permission of Allah. And upon Allah alone let the believers place their trust."
14:12: What is with us that we should not place our trust in Allah? He has shown us our ways. We will surely be patient with what you torment us with. And upon Allah alone let those who place their trust rely.
14:13: Those who disbelieved said to their messengers: 'Either we will drive you out of our land, or you will return to our religion.' Their Rabb revealed to them: 'We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.'
14:14: And We will surely settle you in that land after them. This is for those who fear My station and fear My threat.
14:15: And they sought victory, and every stubborn tyrant was disappointed.
14:16: Behind him is Hell, and he is made to drink of purulent water.
14:17: He sips it sip by sip and can hardly swallow it, death comes to him from every place yet he is not dead, and behind him is a severe punishment.
14:18: The deeds of those who disbelieve in their Rabb are like ashes which the wind blows violently on a stormy day; they have no power over anything from what they have earned.
14:19: Did you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and bring a new creation.
14:20: This is not difficult for Allah.
14:21: They all came forth before Allah. The weak said to those who were arrogant: "We were followers of you; can you now avert anything of Allah's punishment from us?" They said: "If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. Whether we are patient or not patient, it is all the same for us; there is no place of escape for us."
14:22: When the matter was decided, Satan said: "Undoubtedly Allah promised you the promise of truth, and I promised you, but I broke my word. I had no power over you except that I called you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me, blame yourselves. I am not your helper, nor are you my helpers. I already rejected your associating me as partner before." Undoubtedly for the wrongdoers there is a painful punishment.
14:23: Those who believe and do righteous deeds are admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, by the permission of their Rabb, abiding therein eternally.
14:24: Did you not see how Allah set forth an example? A good word is like a good tree whose root is firmly fixed and whose branches are in the sky.
14:25: It gives its fruit at all times by the permission of its Rabb, and Allah sets forth parables for mankind so that perhaps they may take heed.
14:26: And the example of an evil word is like an evil tree, uprooted from above the earth; there is no stability for it.
14:27: Allah keeps those who believe firm with the firm word in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. Allah leads the wrongdoers astray, and Allah does what He wills.
14:28: Did you not see those who exchanged the blessing of Allah for disbelief and settled their people in the abode of destruction?
14:29: They will burn in Hell, and what an evil settlement it is!
14:30: They made equals to Allah to lead astray from His path. Say: Live on, for your return will be to the Fire.
14:31: Tell My servants who believe: Let them establish the prayer (salah) and spend secretly and openly from what We have provided them as sustenance, before a day comes in which there is neither trade nor friendship.
14:32: Allah is the One Who created the heavens and the earth, sent down water from the sky, brought forth fruits therewith as sustenance for you, and made the ships of service to you to sail in the sea by His command, and made the rivers of service to you.
14:33: And He made the sun and the moon of service to you as continuous movers, and He made the night and the day of service to you.
14:34: And He gave you of everything you asked for. If you were to count the blessing of Allah, you could not enumerate it. Undoubtedly man is very unjust, very ungrateful.
14:35: At that time Abraham said: "My Rabb, make this city secure, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols."
14:36: My Rabb, undoubtedly they have led many of mankind astray; so whoever follows me, undoubtedly he is of me, and whoever disobeys me, undoubtedly You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
14:37: Our Rabb! Undoubtedly I have settled some of my offspring in an uncultivated valley near Your Sacred House. Our Rabb, so that they may establish the prayer (salah). So make hearts from among mankind incline toward them and provide them with fruits, so that they may give thanks.
14:38: Our Rabb! Undoubtedly You know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in the sky is hidden from Allah.
14:39: Praise be to that Allah Who granted me Ishmael and Isaac despite my old age; surely my Rabb is the Hearer of prayers.
14:40: My Rabb, make me of those who perform the prayer, and from my children [as well]; our Rabb, and accept my supplication.
14:41: Our Rabb, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day of Reckoning.
14:42: And do not think Allah unaware of what the wrongdoers do; He only defers them to a day when eyes will stare fixedly.
14:43: Hastening forward, their heads raised high, their gaze does not return to them, and their hearts are void.
14:44: Warn the people of the day when the punishment will come upon them. Then those who wronged will say: Our Rabb, defer us for a near term so that we may answer Your call and follow the messengers. Did you not swear beforehand that there would be no demise for you?
14:45: And you dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We set forth examples for you.
14:46: And indeed they set their trap, and their trap is with Allah, even if their trap were to move mountains from their place.
14:47: So do not think Allah to be a breaker of His promise to His messengers. Surely Allah is mighty, possessor of retribution.
14:48: On that day, the earth will be replaced with another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they will come forth before Allah, the One, the al-Kahhar.
14:49: You will see the guilty on that day in chains.
14:50: Their garments are of pitch, and the fire envelops their faces.
14:51: So that Allah may give every soul the recompense of what it earned. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.
14:52: This is a proclamation for people, that they may be warned by it, that they may know that He is one God, and that possessors of intellect may take heed.
